gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Unica One draws every stroke at a single thickness, with big open curves that let the light through. Yet Noto Sans Khudawadi brings a gentler, approachable sans, its capitals barely above the lowercase and its rounds left unlatched, so a long paragraph would read smoothly.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-kr: A lowercase eye so large the curves look hollowed out, all drawn with one unvarying stroke in Unica One, over Noto Sans KR. Generous curves and a big x-height make the pair feel contemporary.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao stands with a x-height pushed well above the usual and mouths that stay open, under Unica One's hairline-uniform strokes. Shrink the heading and its commanding presence thins out.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Unica One traces every letter with one thickness and a huge lowercase eye, which gives it that commanding look. Noto Sans Lao Looped follows with words that read as solid blocks, modern and tidy beneath it.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Commanding in its single-marker lines, Unica One sits over Noto Sans Lepcha, a plain sans whose lowercase has the stature of cast iron capitals. The surprise is how much weight the body holds.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Marker-bold, hollow-eyed letters up top. Below, Noto Sans Limbu has tall-bodied small letters with gaping curves, so a long page of this plain sans would feel open and welcoming, while Unica One stays pinch-free.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Unica One is rope-thin and uniform in every outline. Noto Sans Lisu sits under it as a plain sans with wide-open s curves and tiny gaps near the ascender tops, so the heading's single line meets a body with more texture.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Noto Sans Lydian keeps its capitals barely taller than its lowercase. Unica One, rope-thin with no thick or thin parts, earns its keep when it is big and brief above it.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Distinctive from the first line, Unica One has no thick or thin parts in any letter. Noto Sans Mahajani, a plain sans with a funnel-wide e and lowercase standing tall against its capitals, would read comfortably over a long page.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Constant weight, no sparkle, big hollow curves. Unica One handles the commanding statement, while Noto Sans Malayalam, a plain sans with a dominant middle zone and generous s bends, does the approachable everyday work.
